name: instrumentation
title: evestack dashboard traces
description: Export OpenTelemetry traces from an eve agent to a self-hosted evestack dashboard.
docs: Set EVESTACK_DASHBOARD_URL to your dashboard's ingest endpoint (http://localhost:4000/api/ingest/v1/traces). Leave it unset and no exporter is registered. NOTE: the presence of agent/instrumentation.ts disables eve's zero-config local trace spool, so `eve traces` stops working — delete the file to get it back.
